findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
5-502.11: REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be removed from the PREMISES at a frequency that will minimize the development of objectionable odors and other conditions that attract or harbor insects and rodents. 

On arrival there is a large amount of waste observed filling and around the outside dumpsters. PIC (Kelly Corcoran) indicated that there has been a work order in for this situation for over a month. Records were checked and the first documented work order is dated June 14, 2023. Other dates observed include June 6th (continuing to be pushed back) and July 17. A roll off has been requested and is waiting on a supervisor (for the company/corporate). It was requested and initially approved for June 19th, but has not arrived. Trash service changed last month away from Waste Management due to an “account discrepancy.” At this time Waste Management is who Walgreens is going back to and Astor Company is not picking up as they agreed to in the interim. At this time the City of Springfield has already submitted a citation. Per CK, Food Program Supervisor, SCDPH will spot check in a week to check on compliance.
